lines.en: I studied engineering at university, although I have always been more interested in teaching.
Learning a new language takes time, but it becomes easier once you start using it every day.
She passed the exam because she studied a little every day instead of waiting until the last week.
In my opinion, practical skills are just as important as a university degree when you look for a job.
The teacher explained the lesson twice, so even the students who were confused finally understood.
If I had more free time, I would take a course in graphic design and start working online.
Many young people struggle to find a job because employers usually ask for experience they do not have.
Reading books regularly improves your vocabulary and helps you express your ideas more clearly.
He was nervous about the interview, but he had practiced his answers so many times that he felt confident.
Whether you learn at school or by yourself, the most important thing is to stay curious and keep going.
